levelHabit.name: Level Habit
levelHabit.description: A full-stack gamified habit tracker that helps users build routines, earn XP, maintain streaks, unlock achievements and follow their progress over time.

dialog.title: Level Habit
dialog.description: Level Habit is a responsive full-stack application that turns personal habit building into a progression system. Users can securely manage their habits, complete daily tasks, earn experience, increase their level, build streaks, unlock achievements and review detailed activity analytics.
tasks: Build a responsive Angular application with protected routes and user-focused dashboards
Create a secure ASP.NET Core REST API with JWT authentication and user-scoped data
Implement habit management, daily completions, XP, levels, streaks and achievements
Create progress and activity analytics from habit completion history
Add email verification, password recovery and secure refresh-token authentication
Add automated frontend, backend, accessibility and end-to-end tests
Configure CI/CD and deploy the frontend, API and PostgreSQL database
